messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Aqualine dropped ~65% weekly API calls starting last Wednesday. Saw spike in inactive seats. New Head of Data started last week and they said NexServe is doing a features/price comparison. Can we triage?

sam_eng: Looking at logs now. 200s still ~99.9%, no obvious errors. Latency normal. Did they change client keys or throttle?

kevin_aqualine: Hi team — sorry for the radio silence. We put a temporary budget hold while the new Head of Data runs vendor comparisons. We're not canceling, just paused customer-facing calls for cost reasons.

adele_sales: Thanks Kevin. Can you share who the new Head of Data is and their timeline? We can offer a short technical workshop + cost breakdown for execs. @maria_cs — can you prep an ROI slide and a short demo? :slightly_smiling_face:

nora_pm: Quick ask — confirm whether they used prefix caching and batching in the pilot. If they turned those off during integration, cost/perf will look worse.

maria_cs: Kevin — is the pause applied at the team-level or org-level? Also: any internal notes the new lead shared?

kevin_aqualine: Pause is org-level for now. The new lead is Dana Ortiz, starting Mar 2. She wants a head-to-head on throughput and inference cost. Timeline: internal decision in 3 weeks.

sam_eng: If they want throughput/cost numbers, we should run a short regen: same prompts, both models, two quantization configs. I can spin a dedicated run and export token-level cost. Need their sample prompt set and peak seq len.

adele_sales: Proposal: offer a 30-day extended trial with a dedicated perf report + one-hour exec briefing. Discount optional if they commit to a Dedicated evaluation. Thoughts?

maria_cs: Agree. Playbook: 1) confirm sample prompts + traffic shape (Kevin) 2) Sam runs perf/cost bench 3) we schedule 1-hr workshop for Dana + procurement 4) provide one-slide ROI + three quick wins.

kevin_aqualine: I'll ask Dana for the prompt set today and share procurement timeline. Also, she asked for a short writeup comparing caching behavior vs NexServe — would you include that?

nora_pm: Yes — include caching, batching, model variants we propose, and fallback policies. Keep it 1 page.

maria_cs: Assigning owners: sam_eng -> bench, maria_cs -> ROI + workshop deck, adele_sales -> trial terms + commercial. I'll set a tentative workshop for Mar 10 at 11am PT — Kevin can confirm.

oncall-bot: Deploy notice: dedicated-bench-runner v2 started (job id: bench-2026-03-03-77). Sam will get artifacts when complete.

kevin_aqualine: Confirmed Mar 10 works for Dana. Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn.

maria_cs: Action items summarized: Sam: bench + export token cost (ETA 48h). Maria: one-slide ROI + workshop deck (ETA 48h). Adele: draft trial terms (ETA EOD). Kevin: share prompt set + procurement window (ETA EOD). We'll reconvene in this thread once bench artifacts are in. :thumbsup:
